page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by custom AWS Graviton ARMv9 processors using the Neoverse-V3 microarchitecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a cache hierarchy consisting of 64 KB L1d, 2 MB L2, and 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the m9gd.8xlarge demonstrates top-tier performance in several key areas. Single-core and multi-core Geekbench scores rank in the top 10%, alongside exceptional results in software compilation with Clang and text processing. Single-threaded data compression and decompression tasks via gzip and bzip3 also achieve top-tier status. Memory performance is highlighted by a top-tier Passmark memory score and strong small-block read-only memory bandwidth. Database operations and static web serving throughput both register in the top 10%, while Redis SET operations and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests show strong top-25% performance. Conversely, large-block memory bandwidth and LLM inference speeds for 135M and 7B models fall into the average category.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture combined with high-density local NVMe storage provides a resource-dense profile that reduces reliance on external network-attached storage. The absence of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU, which is highly beneficial for predictable performance. This server is optimized for workloads such as high-throughput database operations, static web serving, software compilation pipelines, and data compression tasks.
description: Amazon Web Services m9gd.8xlarge is an ARM64 general-purpose server powered by 32 dedicated physical cores of the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V3 processor running at 3.3 GHz. It features 128.0 GB of RAM, a bundled 1900 GB NVMe SSD local instance store, and 17 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Operating on the Nitro hypervisor, this instance delivers top-tier performance in software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and single-threaded data compression. While large-block memory bandwidth and LLM inference speeds remain average, its dedicated core design and high-speed local storage offer excellent resource density. This server is recommended for database hosting, CI/CD compilation pipelines, web serving, and high-throughput data processing workloads.
